page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 274 at left. Below it a decorative rule, then a division heading SECVLVM V. with subheading PELAGIANI. Then one block of running text in roman and italic, a decorative rule, a heading CASTIGATIO., and a final paragraph of roman text ending mid-word at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.head: SECVLVM V. PELAGIANI.

p.i: PElagiani â Pelagio monacho, ex magna Britannia oriundo, dicti, qui etiam Coelestini â Coelestio Pelagij affectatore nominati sunt) docent, naturalibus viribus, solius liberi arbitrij vi, sine Dei gratia justitiam Dei consequi nos posse. Pueros non egere baptismo ad deletionem peccati originalis, quòd ante baptismum nullum habeant peccatum. Traditiones respuunt, referente D. Aug. lib. de natura & gratia cap. 39. in hac verba. Credamus igitur quod legimus, & quod non legimus nefas credemus astruere, quod de cunctis etiam dixisse sufficiet.

main_text.head: CASTIGATIO.
main_text.p: Progreditur Jesuita ad seculum quintum, & in eo Pelagianis primum locum assignat. De Pelagii ortu, patria, & perni

page.notes: Decorative rules and ornaments omitted. Text in the first paragraph is italic; the last line of the page is cut off at the right edge ("perni" likely "pernicie" or "perniciem"; not certain).
